provenance.task: D20 partial (§8 performance data path) — bench-gate baseline inventory
provenance.host: Darwin (darwin), arm64 — NOT the §8 reference environment (Linux, 8 vCPU, 16GiB, SSD)
provenance.note: Absolute numbers are only comparable on the same host and toolchain; this baseline catches regressions on the SAME machine. Recorded alongside micro_baseline.json (which covers BenchmarkDecodeEventDataTransfer only, because .github/workflows/metrics.yml runs that benchmark alone — a superset baseline there would fail the gate's no-match rule). bytes_per_op is omitted for benchmarks whose measured mean was exactly 0 B/op (no allocation): bench-gate treats a non-positive baseline value as a failure, and an omitted metric is skipped by design. Affected: BenchmarkInMemoryCache_Get, BenchmarkInMemoryCache_GetStats, BenchmarkInMemoryCache_ParallelReads.
